answer: RF hardware fingerprinting resists Sybil attacks in an AI-agent economy by tying each identity to analog radio tolerances. Gateways sample raw baseband signals of signed nonce packets to extract each node's quartz crystal frequency offset and I/Q skew, dropping clones with matching profiles. Faking identities requires separate radios per node rather than software replicas, yet multipath fading in an urban canyon or swaying garden foliage can distort signatures and lock out honest agents.
